scope: Curated public-source profiles as of November 23, 2026; status may have changed after document date.
method: Program-specific dated-source summaries. Company statements, trial registrations, peer-reviewed publications and patents are distinct evidence types. Search leads are not legal FTO assessments.

companies.name: Indaptus Therapeutics

programs.name: Decoy20
programs.outcome: Further enrollment was discontinued during Q2 2026; no participants remained in active clinical studies, and further Decoy20 development activity was substantially reduced. The company continued to evaluate strategic alternatives and scientific uses of the assets.

companies.mechanism: Nonliving bacterial preparations designed to activate broad innate and adaptive antitumor immunity (company-described).
companies.clinical: No active clinical development program was reported in the November 2026 filing; this is not evidence that the candidate achieved clinical efficacy.
companies.publication: Scientific mechanism and early-phase program disclosures are available, but no current active efficacy trial is established in the cited filings.
companies.patent: Decoy platform patent family may be relevant; a search alone does not establish ownership, claim scope, validity, or freedom to operate.
